description.value: Sushi Sei is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, offering both dine-in and online ordering options. Touring cyclists can stop in for a fresh sushi meal and Japanese cuisine in a casual dining environment. The restaurant's central location makes it accessible to cyclists passing through the Kingsway corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 14m; stands (1 space) at 66m; stands (1 space) at 78m. Total: 2 spaces.
